description: The chart is a donut chart representing the win rates of different language models in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini. There are four slices in the chart, each representing a different language model. The largest slice, representing Mistral, occupies approximately 88.0% of the chart and is colored in a light blue shade. The second largest slice, representing LLaMA, takes up about 80.4% of the chart and is colored in a darker blue shade. The third slice, representing GPT-4o, is colored in a red shade and accounts for 19.6% of the chart. The smallest slice, also representing GPT-4o, is colored in a dark red shade and makes up 12.0% of the chart. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
